component.name: VOCO
component.summary: The voice layer for Linux, starting with dictation

description.p: Dictation is the first step. VOCO is building the voice layer for Linux: private, local, and under your control. Press a shortcut, speak, and VOCO pastes your words into the app you are typing in. Speech is recognized on your computer, with no account, subscription or cloud service. VOCO listens only when you start it and never presses Enter.
VOCO stays in the system tray, or in the GNOME top bar with live microphone bars. Pasting depends on your desktop session and the app you type in.

ul.li: Local English speech recognition with NVIDIA Nemotron
Words appear while you speak, in whichever app has keyboard focus
Words VOCO cannot paste are copied to the clipboard when you stop, and Review recovers dictation after a crash
Update checks against GitHub Releases; VOCO never downloads or installs updates itself

description.p: VOCO introduces itself as the voice layer for Linux, starting with dictation. Its app framework and build tools are up to date, and dictation works as before on Ubuntu 24.04 and 26.04, Debian 13 and Fedora 44.

Dictation pastes into whatever app has keyboard focus. On Wayland VOCO types the paste keys through its own virtual keyboard, so there is no input service to set up. If pasting stops, VOCO keeps listening and copies the words it could not paste when you stop, and Review keeps dictation after a crash.
VOCO supports Ubuntu 24.04 and 26.04, Debian 13 and Fedora 44, and its GNOME top-bar panel runs on GNOME 46, 48 and 50. After upgrading, run panel setup again, then sign out and back in.
Release rejected GNOME shortcut reservations promptly and preserve newer accepted renewals.
Preserve Brave address-bar dictation when stopping with Alt+D, consume Stop on GNOME Wayland, and retain held Stop gestures across recording status changes.

Return directly to the tray after onboarding, retain local transcription after delivery interruptions with recovery on request, and introduce a prominent silver installer wordmark with branded progress accents.
Open VOCO after guided installation, support focused Ghostty terminal panes, and preserve microphone readiness when a destination is unavailable.
Improve destination checks and native capture latency, verify installer signatures, and prevent legacy Wayland input service exhaustion.
Updated Vite, React and Tauri build dependencies, preserving live tray feedback with the updated tray library.
Test live local speech during onboarding and check for an editable cursor before dictation.
Safer capture admission, offline recovery, and public evaluation tools.
Adds persistent VOCO Dictation input-source support with revisable live preedit, authoritative local checkpoints, exact-prefix delivery, and recoverable fail-closed final transcripts.
Unifies tray and settings state, adds safe configuration recovery and single-instance ownership, and hardens model-cache integrity, installers, private IPC, and release verification.
Adds bounded 10-minute dictation, chunked local transcription, append-only live cursor previews, and safer final transcript reconciliation.
Simplifies settings to direct cursor dictation, removes assistant modes, and improves settings-window dragging.
